coupling_convention: g_BL (dimensionless), canonical B-L gauge coupling as plotted on y-axis
notes: Torsion-balance search for ultra low-mass bosonic dark matter coupled to baryon minus lepton number (B-L). Best limit at m_DM = 8×10^-18 eV/c^2 constraining g_BL(hbar*c)^(-1/2) < 1×10^-25. Mass range searched: 10^-18 to 10^-16 eV/c^2 (0.1 mHz to 50 mHz). The coupling values are mass-independent over the stated range, encoded as a horizontal line. Local DM density assumed: ρ_DM ≈ 0.3 GeV/cm^3. The paper notes that results are taken for spans shorter than the coherence time and may require corrections for long-term field averages.
